items.title: Lou Donaldson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I think I read on a liner note for one of your recordings that you were in a session or two with Bud Powell. Mmm-hmm. Yeah.

ctx.x: What else did you do that first visit to New York?

I went by the Onyx Club, too, to see my favorites. And very depressing. Heh-heh. The Onyx Club. That was on 52nd Street, too. They had J.J. and Sonny Stitt, Bud Powell, Miles, and every one of them was all messed up. It was terrible. Very depressing.
